$comment: 2012 changes on top of the era base's rules (bases/dtm-era4/patches/regulations.json, applied first): no DRS and no option tyre yet (both came in 2013), and 1,100 kg instead of 1,110 kg. The two car options keep their base keys, so this replaces them.

add_options.name: DTM 2012
add_options.summary: Carbon-chassis DTM coupes with about 470 hp and 1,100 kg.
add_options.description: The new 2012 DTM cars (Audi A5, BMW M3, AMG C-Coupe). They corner far faster than Group A saloons but stay well below single-seaters. Same settings as the 2013 cars, which were fitted to the 2013 qualifying times.

add_options.name: DTM 2012
add_options.summary: 1,100 kg including the driver for every make.
add_options.description: One minimum weight for all three makes and no success ballast. The chassis figure here excludes the engine mass the game adds on top.
